name: picking a service fills in its address
js: const p = t.$('#setProvider'); p.value = 'https://api.openai.com/v1'; p.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return [t.$('#setApiBase').value, t.$('#setApiBaseRow').hidden, t.$('#setApiKeyRow').hidden, t.$('#setProxyNote').hidden, t.$('#setApiKey').type]

name: a wrong key shows the API's error
js: const p = t.$('#setProvider'); p.value = 'other'; p.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); t.$('#setApiBase').value = '127.0.0.1:18734/v1/chat/completions/'; t.$('#setApiKey').value = 'wrong-key'; t.$('#settingsDialog').close(); await t.until(() => t.$('#status .status-text').textContent === 'Not connected', 10000); await t.sleep(600); return [t.toast(), t.$('#status').title, t.state().settings.apiBase]

name: the right key lists the chat models
js: t.$('#settingsBtn').click(); const r = [t.$('#setProvider').value, t.$('#setApiBase').value]; t.$('#setApiKey').value = 'test-key'; t.$('#settingsDialog').close(); await t.until(() => t.$('#status .status-text').textContent.includes('model'), 10000); await t.sleep(600); const s = t.state().settings; return [r, t.$('#status .status-text').textContent, [...t.$('#modelSelect').options].map(o => o.value), s.model, s.provider, s.apiKey]

name: use the model that rejects parameters
js: const s = t.$('#modelSelect'); s.value = 'mock-reasoner'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await t.sleep(300); return t.state().settings.model

name: chat streams a reply from the API
js: t.$('#input').value = 'What is a Bloom filter?'; t.$('#composer').requestSubmit(); await t.until(() => !t.$('#stopBtn').hidden, 5000); await t.until(() => t.$('#stopBtn').hidden, 20000); await t.sleep(600); const s = t.state(); const m = s.chat[s.chat.length - 1]; const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('.msg.assistant .msg-body')].pop(); return [m.content, m.thinking, m.error || null, !!el.querySelector('strong')]
expect: A **Bloom filter** is a probabilistic set.

name: notes extracted through the API
js: await t.until(() => t.$('#extractStatus').textContent === '' && document.querySelectorAll('.node').length > 2, 20000); await t.sleep(300); const titles = [...document.querySelectorAll('.node .node-title')].map(n => n.textContent); return [titles.includes('Bloom filter'), titles.includes('False positive rate'), t.toast()]

name: the key is sent, and rejected parameters are dropped one at a time
js: const log = await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:18734/log')).json(); return log.filter(r => r.path === '/v1/chat/completions').map(r => [r.auth, r.model, r.stream, r.temperature, r.format])

name: reconnects to the API after a reload
back to Ollama
js: t.$('#settingsBtn').click(); const p = t.$('#setProvider'); p.value = 'ollama'; p.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); const rows = [t.$('#setApiBaseRow').hidden, t.$('#setProxyNote').hidden]; t.$('#settingsDialog').close(); await t.until(() => !['connecting…', '127.0.0.1 · 2 models'].includes(t.$('#status .status-text').textContent), 10000); await t.sleep(600); const s = t.state().settings; return [rows, s.provider, s.apiKey, t.$('#status .status-text').textContent.startsWith('Ollama')]
